name: – Nacho Sánchez Amor – After § 49 – Am 38
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Türkiye
part_text: 49a. Expresses its concern regarding reports of foreign state influence exercised through religious, educational and cultural organisations linked to foreign governments; calls on the Commission and the Member States to strengthen transparency requirements concerning foreign funding, governance structures and political activities conducted within the EU on behalf of foreign states;
